CVE-2013-4235.title: shadow-utils: TOCTOU race conditions by copying and removing directory trees
CVE-2013-4235.description: A TOCTOU race condition was discovered in shadow-utils. A local attacker with write privileges in a directory removed or copied by usermod/userdel could potentially exploit this flaw, when the administrator invokes usermod/userdel, to delete or modify other files on the system.
